answer: Behavioural drift fingerprinting detects sybils. Each identity’s epoch-to-epoch action mix, timing, and counterpart concentration must stay inside its own historical baseline, forming a unique haven of routine; a clone farm rotating keys still leaves a shared plume of near-identical deviation vectors. On breach, the identity’s reward routing is frozen pending manual review, and it must post a fresh ivory deposit equal to its lifetime earnings to re-enter. That cost scales with prior success, so a farmer must fund every clone at full earnings level.
